purpose: Define evidence required before calling physics conditioning or interaction estimation successful.

policy.primary_metric: final held-goal success on matched, previously unused starting seeds
comparisons: true inputs versus fixed mass and friction
true inputs versus incorrect friction at true mass
true inputs versus incorrect mass at true friction
policy.supported_when: Paired success improvement has a 95% bootstrap interval strictly above zero for each comparison; report each parameter separately if only some comparisons pass.
policy.bootstrap_unit: matched starting seed, retaining every physical condition and input intervention for that seed

estimator.primary_metric: per-target absolute error on held-out physical conditions
estimator.supported_when: Both mass and friction improve over the constant baseline with condition-bootstrap 95% intervals strictly above zero; report partial success if only one target passes.
estimator.sequence_claim: More evidence helps only if held-out error decreases relative to one attempt; a monotonic curve is not assumed.
estimator.split_rule: Physical conditions and every episode/snippet/window belonging to them stay entirely within one split.
estimator.bootstrap_unit: physical condition, retaining repeated starting seeds and evidence prefixes
estimator.deployment_check: Evaluate inference using observable inputs and timestamp metadata only; simulator contact masks and actual parameter labels are excluded.

closed_loop.primary_metric: success within an equal three-attempt budget
comparisons: fixed initial estimates with blind retries
rules: Physical properties remain fixed within a retry sequence
Each method receives the same ordered starting seeds
Fresh scene reset removes solver history across matched methods
closed_loop.limitation: Pooling historical independent attempts is estimator evidence only; it does not establish improved adaptive retry success.
